overall_goal: Cover the mushrooms with foil, weigh them down with a baking tray, and roast them in the oven.

goals.description: Cover the mushrooms with foil and weigh them down with a baking tray
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a sheet of foil, covers the mushrooms, and places a heavier baking tray on top to weigh them down.

goals.description: Place the mushrooms in the oven and set the timer
goals.rationale: The person picks up the stacked baking trays, puts them in the oven, and sets the roasting timer.
